title: Risk overlay: medical, legal, financial, or safety-regulated work
description: High-stakes domains where this framework structures the task but never substitutes for a qualified professional. See PRD Phase 12.

rules.title: Never imply the output replaces professional review
rules.purpose: Prevent a structured, confident-looking contract from being mistaken for licensed advice.
rules.requirement: The deliverable must state plainly that it is informational, not professional medical/legal/financial advice, and must name the expert review step still required before anyone acts on it.
rules.evidence_requirement: The disclosure and escalation step are present in the deliverable itself, not only in surrounding chat.
rules.source_or_rationale: PRD Phase 12: 'Never claim that a generic domain pack replaces a qualified professional.'

rules.title: Sources must be current, authoritative, and dated
rules.purpose: Prevent stale or jurisdiction-mismatched guidance from being presented as current.
rules.requirement: Every factual claim cites a source with its jurisdiction (where applicable) and access date; no fabricated citation is permitted.
rules.evidence_requirement: status.verified_facts entries include source and date for high-stakes claims.
rules.source_or_rationale: PRD Phase 12: 'Require current authoritative sources... Record jurisdiction and date... Prohibit fabricated citations.'

rules.title: No automatic external action in high-stakes domains
rules.purpose: Keep a human decision-maker in the loop for consequential actions.
rules.requirement: No filing, submission, purchase, or other external action may be taken automatically; the task stops at a recommendation with a named escalation condition.
rules.evidence_requirement: control.escalation_conditions names the required human/professional review step.
rules.source_or_rationale: PRD Phase 12: 'Prevent automatic external action by default... Provide escalation conditions.'
